newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-ENGLAND TAKE FIRST INNINGS LEAD VS NZ XI. [CORRECTED 5:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND TAKE FIRST INNINGS LEAD VS NZ XI. [CORRECTED 5:40 GMT]

text.p: England had reached 154-3 to take a first innings lead of 16 over the New
Zealand Selection XI on the second day of their four-day match when rain forced play to be adandoned at lunch on Tuesday.
(Corrects score and lead to reflect new score issued by official
New Zealand Selection XI 138 (Craig Spearman 41, Craig White 4-15)
England 154 for three (Nick Knight 46, Alec Stewart 75 not out).
